title: edgeforge, Efficiency & Unit Economics
description: What does it cost, and which way is it going? Audience: engineering leadership, finance. Panels map to SLIs D1-D7.
__comment_axes: No dual-axis panels anywhere on this dashboard. Dollars and percentages are
never plotted against two y-scales, comparisons are indexed to a common
base instead. A dual-axis cost chart is the fastest way to make a trend say

panels.__comment: Hero number. This is the figure that goes in a board pack, so it gets the whole top-left and nothing competes with it.
panels.title: Cost per robot-month
panels.description: D7. The objective is a DIRECTION, not a level; the absolute figure depends on fleet size, so a threshold would be meaningless. The claim under test is that unit economics improve as the fleet grows. Evaluated as a 90-day regression slope; must not be positive.

panels.title: 90-day trend
panels.description: The slope of the hero number. Negative is the objective. Status colour is paired with an explicit up/down word, never colour alone.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
SloStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(2h) and slo_id_s == 'D7'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, observed_d)
| project slope_usd_per_day = observed_d

panels.title: Label auto-accept rate
panels.description: D1. The single biggest cost lever in the platform: each point is roughly $350/month at the 40-robot design point. Objective >= 70%.

panels.title: Cost per labeled frame
panels.description: D2. Ceiling $0.32. Falls as the auto-accept rate rises; these two panels move together, which is the point of putting them side by side.

panels.title: Cost per production release
panels.description: D6. Ceiling $34k over 90 days. Every pipeline event carries attributable_cost_usd, which is what makes this a measurement rather than a monthly reconciliation exercise.

__comment: Stacked area, spend by stage. 2px surface gap between stacked segments.
Three categorical slots only, past three the all-pairs colour floors
cannot be met, so the long tail folds into 'other' rather than
panels.title: Spend by stage
panels.description: Labeling dominates and is the line most sensitive to engineering effort. Everything below 'other' is aggregated deliberately: a fourth series here would need a hue that cannot be told apart from the third under colour-vision deficiency.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
PipelineEvents_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| extend bucket = case(
    stage_s in ('autolabel', 'human_adjudication'), 'labeling',
    stage_s in ('pretrain', 'finetune', 'distill', 'sweep'), 'training',
    stage_s == 'storage', 'storage',
    'other')
| summarize spend = sum(attributable_cost_usd_d) by bucket, bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Compute efficiency
panels.description: D4 GPU utilization (allocated, not provisioned; a cluster scaled to zero is not idle capacity) and D5 spot share. Final training runs are excluded from D5's denominator: a preempted 40-hour job costs more than spot saves.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AmlComputeJobEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(28d)
| summarize
    ['GPU utilization'] = sum(GpuSecondsBusy) / sum(GpuSecondsAllocated),
    ['Spot share (interruptible)'] = sumif(GpuHours, Priority == 'LowPriority') / sumif(GpuHours, JobType in ('sweep','simulation','batch_inference'))

panels.__comment: Indexed to a common base rather than a second axis; the whole reason this panel is legible.
panels.title: Unit economics, indexed to day 0 = 100
panels.description: Cost per robot-month, cost per labeled frame, and cost per release on one indexed scale. The claim to read off this panel: all three should trend down while fleet size trends up.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
UnitEconomics_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
| extend base_robot = toscalar(UnitEconomics_CL | top 1 by TimeGenerated asc | project cost_per_robot_month_d)
| extend base_frame = toscalar(UnitEconomics_CL | top 1 by TimeGenerated asc | project cost_per_labeled_frame_d)
| extend base_release = toscalar(UnitEconomics_CL | top 1 by TimeGenerated asc | project cost_per_release_d)
| project TimeGenerated,
    cost_per_robot_month = 100.0 * cost_per_robot_month_d / base_robot,
    cost_per_labeled_frame = 100.0 * cost_per_labeled_frame_d / base_frame,
    cost_per_release = 100.0 * cost_per_release_d / base_release

panels.title: SLO status (efficiency group
panels.description: Generated by src/edgeforge/fleet/slo.py. A breach here is a cost conversation, not an incident), but it is on a dashboard for the same reason everything else is.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
SloStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(2h) and group_s == 'efficiency'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by slo_id_s
| project id = slo_id_s, indicator = name_s, observed = observed_d, objective = objective_d, budget_remaining_pct = budget_remaining_pct_d, status = status_s
| order by id asc
